notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
Changelog:

Bugs:

- All beds now have collisions

Improvements:

- Light performance optimizations

- Shadows improvements and optimizations

- The bureau agent will knock on the door every 30 seconds

Gameplay:

- New “Devoted” difficulty for the players looking to escape by the skin of their teeth.

- Move some light switches for a better gameplay (no, it’s not the bathroom one, it stays on the outside for gameplay reasons)

notes.title: Calling all creators!
notes.content:
🚪Post a YouTube Short or TikTok featuring yourself playing "Shut the Windows and Don't Look Outside" with the hashtag #ShutTheWindows for a chance to win $30 every week!

💰 How to Win:

🎥 Create and post a Short/TikTok of your best jumpscare, gameplay, review, or even your wildest theories!

🔥 The clip with the most views at the end of the week wins $30 cash!

🎮 Don't forget to include the demo link in your post!

This contest runs every week until the end of the Kickstarter campaign, with the deadline for the first prize on the 13th of April at 00:00(GMT) ! Think you can take the top spot? Prove it!

#ShutTheWindows 🚪👀

notes.title: A Community is born!
notes.content:
Join [url=https://discord.gg/zUv9P5pZyF]DISCORD HERE[/url]

First public notice:

First and foremost, we want to extend a huge thank you to everyone for the incredible support and enthusiasm following the release of our demo. We truly appreciate your patience and understanding, especially as the demo launched with a few rough edges. Your feedback—both positive and critical—has been invaluable, and we are committed to refining and expanding the experience as we move toward the full release.

We’re excited to share that a Steam launch is on the horizon, accompanied by giveaways and special opportunities for you to become an even bigger part of the project. In the meantime, we invite you to join our Discord server, where you can stay up to date with the latest announcements, share your thoughts, and connect with fellow supporters.

Once again, thank you for being part of this journey. Your support means the world to us and is helping shape the game into something truly special.

Everyone has their part to play.
